summary.text: Jen Mazzocco (listed by Ballotpedia as Jennifer Mazzocco) is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 42 who won a February 24, 2026 special election and took office on March 23, 2026.
A teacher, she is seeking a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Mazzocco earned a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from the University of Pittsburgh, and her career experience includes working as a teacher.
Ballotpedia lists her as affiliated with the Pittsburgh Federation of Teachers.
Mazzocco defeated Republican Joseph Leckenby in the February 24, 2026 special general election for District 42, succeeding Dan Miller.
She advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary, in which she received 99.5 percent of the vote.
